findings.claim: Acceptance requires complete supplied visibility into the target-owned runtime producer/context changes or blocker deliverable before goal-001 can receive a semantic verdict.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff visibility contract is complete=false and truncated=true. The delivered diff does not review the target-owned be-validator-agent caller/context paths, and plans/monitoring/runtime-producer-context-contract.md is filtered from review even though the checkpoint says it was updated as the conditional blocker deliverable. Omitted or filtered paths cannot establish either correctness or absence.
findings.rationale: The task permits either an approved real-caller integration or, when the authoritative execution interface is absent, an exact blocker record. Because the evidence for both target-owned alternatives is outside supplied review visibility, accepting would be unsupported, while a missing-implementation correctness finding would improperly infer from omitted paths.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied diff or equivalent review artifact covering the target-owned be-validator-agent caller/context paths and plans/monitoring/runtime-producer-context-contract.md so the conditional implementation-or-blocker requirement can be assessed.

goals.summary: Monitoring runtime: dokončit doložený producer a immutable execution context
